thread:
maya: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — summary of proposed owners, timelines, and recurring-patterns work for the multi-vendor outage (cloud provider auth spikes + model-registry flakiness).

maya: TL;DR: two short mitigations to ship this week, longer hardening and drill in the next 3 sprints. I'll put items into the action tracker after we agree owners. :spiral_note_pad:

alex: I can take the cloud fallback automation (ensure cross-region routing and explicit retry windows). Plan: prototype runbook + dry-run by EOD Friday.

jordan: I'll pick up model-registry auth TTL rotation + improved error surface (400/401/5xx split) and add synthetic checks. Target: PR by next Tue.

anika: I'll own alerting and runbook updates (incorporating the new checks). Will add pager thresholds and a short playbook. Aim to merge alerts by Thu.

liam: We should schedule a cross-team failover drill (auth + registry + routing). Suggest week-after-next Wednesday for the drill. I can coordinate calendars and the checklist.

maya: Concrete action items I'm proposing now: 
- A1: cloud fallback automation (owner: alex) — dry-run Fri, merge next Tue.
- A2: registry auth TTL & error taxonomy (owner: jordan) — PR next Tue, rollout canary Thu.
- A3: alerts + runbook (owner: anika) — thresholds + runbook update by Thu.
- A4: failover drill (owner: liam) — plan doc by Mon, drill Weds week-after-next.
- A5: short-term mitigations (owner: maya) — increase auth retry backoff to 500ms -> 2s for 1 minute during detected spikes (temp).

maya: Quick note on recurring patterns we saw: auth token bursts at 20:45 UTC correlate with provider control-plane throttles; model registry 5xxs are clustered around scaling windows. We should instrument: 1) auth provider 429/5xx rate per minute, 2) model-registry queue length and 5xx smoothed rate, 3) fallback success-rate for cross-region reads.

alex: For A1 I'll add a small shim that routes to secondary region if 3 consecutive auth calls fail within 30s, with a circuit-breaker. Question: do we prefer immediate fallback or exponential backoff + retry first?

anika: prefer: retry (3x small backoff) then fallback. But track fallback metric separately so we can detect increased reliance on fallback. Add an alert if fallback rate > 1% over 5m.

jordan: For the registry TTL rotation, I'll also add a canary that hits the registry every 15s and records 5xx/latency. Will post the check config in the tracker.

liam: Drill plan: we simulate auth provider region outage and ensure model-serving falls back to pinned cached model and that console shows degraded-but-operational. Will include runbook steps for rollback.

maya: Admin notes: I'll create the action-tracker row with IDs A1..A5, set priorities, and assign owners. Please comment on the tracker if timelines change. I'll add recurrence observation: if auth spikes > 2 times in 2 weeks, we escalate vendor SLA review.

deploy-bot: IncidentBot: runbook "vendor-fallbacks" updated by anika — https://redwood.internal/runbooks/vendor-fallbacks :white_check_mark:

alex: putting a short checklist in the PR:
```
- enable fallback shim behind feature flag
- unit tests for retry logic
- load test 1k rps for 60s
- monitor fallback metric after deploy
```

jordan: I'll also add a logging field to registry responses to surface upstream provider IDs for correlation. That should help root-cause recurring patterns.

anika: one more ask — can we add a weekly 15m "vendor-surge" sync to the incidents channel for the next 6 weeks? Quick status, owners update, and any newly observed patterns.

maya: yes, let's do Wednesdays 09:30 PT for 6 weeks. I'll schedule and invite alex/jordan/anika/liam.

liam: ack. I'll draft the drill checklist and post in the tracker by Monday.

maya: Great. I'll create the tracker entries now and ping when done. :thumbsup:

anika: :eyes: thanks — I'll update the alerts after PRs land.

alex: starting prototyping now, will update in the tracker when dry-run infra is ready.

maya: Closing loop — owners: alex(A1), jordan(A2), anika(A3), liam(A4), maya(A5). Deadlines summarized in tracker. If anyone needs to swap ownership, comment there.

maya: End of thread — I'll post the tracker link in this thread when created.
